KC-01-1710 · passive, every signal straight through
Carries the B-side lines: B_INT_1–12, B_INT_SAFE(2), I2C bus,
RST, the expansion bus (SDA/SCL_EXT, EXT_INT_1/2), FAN_PWM, 12 V
CN1 34-pin · 8 module slots · safe-switch terminal U4
CN1 34-pin · 8 module slots · safe-switch terminal U4
Module in a hub slot (16-pin IDC)
USB (Micro-USB to each Teensy 4.1; USB-C at the rear)
Panel switch wiring to screw terminals
Cable tag: connector pin count, cable part number (to be assigned)

Shaded boards are panel hubs. Each hub slot carries 12 V, the I2C bus, RST and one INT line. Module boxes: I2C address · INT line, then the assembly part number (KC-01-XXX0). Sources: Hardware Inventory §2–§7, Hardware Reference §3.6, §5, §7, §10.
